description_en: Queries the details of a bandwidth plan by calling the DescribeBandwidthPackage operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeBandwidthPackage接口查询带宽包详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga describe-bandwidth-package --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id gbwp-bp1sgzldyj6b4q7cx0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBandwidthPackage

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bandwidth plan to query
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

Accelerators.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance attached to the bandwidth plan
Accelerators.description_zh: 带宽包绑定的全球加速实例ID

items.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance attached to the bandwidth plan
items.description_zh: 带宽包绑定的全球加速实例ID

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth value of the bandwidth plan. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 带宽包的带宽值，单位为Mbps

BandwidthType.description_en:
The bandwidth type. Valid values:

Basic: standard acceleration bandwidth.

Enhanced: enhanced acceleration bandwidth.

Advanced: premium acceleration bandwidth
BandwidthType.description_zh:
带宽类型。

Basic：标准加速带宽。

Enhanced：增强加速带宽。

Advanced：精品加速带宽

BillingType.description_en:
The billable methods for the pay-as-you-go billing method. Valid values:
PayByTraffic: pay-by-data-transfer.
PayBY95: pay-by-95th-percentile
BillingType.description_zh:
后付费计费方式，取值：
PayByTraffic：流量计费。
PayBY95：95计费

CbnGeographicRegionIdA.description_en:
The interconnected area A of the cross-border acceleration bandwidth plan. The value is returned only as China-mainland (the Chinese mainland).

This parameter is returned only on the Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com)
CbnGeographicRegionIdA.description_zh:
跨地域加速包的互通区域A。仅返回为China-mainland（中国内地）。

仅国际站支持返回该参数

CbnGeographicRegionIdB.description_en:
The interconnected area B of the cross-border acceleration bandwidth plan. The value is returned only as Global.

This parameter is returned only on the Chinese site (Chinese mainland)
CbnGeographicRegionIdB.description_zh:
跨地域加速包的互通区域B。仅返回为Global（全球）。

仅国际站支持返回该参数

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PREPAY (default): subscription.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型。
PREPAY（默认值）：预付费，即包年包月。
POSTPAY：后付费，即按量付费

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the bandwidth plan was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 带宽包创建时间的时间戳

Description.description_en: The description of the bandwidth plan

ExpiredTime.description_en: The timestamp when the bandwidth plan expires
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 带宽包过期时间的时间戳

Name.description_en: The name of the bandwidth plan

Ratio.description_en: The minimum percentage for the pay-by-95th-percentile metering method. Valid values: 30 to 100

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
RegionId.description_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou

State.description_en:
The status of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

init: initialization.

active: active.

binded: attached.

binding: being attached.

unbinding: being disassociated.

updating: being updated.

finacialLocked: locked due to overdue payment.

locked: locked
State.description_zh:
带宽包的状态。

init：初始化。

active：可用。

binded：已绑定。

binding：绑定中。

unbinding：解绑中。

updating：更新中。

finacialLocked：欠费锁定。

locked：已锁定

Type.description_en:
The type of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

Basic: basic bandwidth plan.

CrossDomain: cross-border acceleration bandwidth plan.

Only Basic is returned on the Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com)
Type.description_zh:
带宽包的类型。

Basic：基础带宽包。

CrossDomain：跨地域加速包。

中国站仅支持返回Basic
